# v0.9.0 release aggregation plan

Aggregate the existing release fragments with the approved Make helper, then add a short release introduction. This is release preparation only. Dimensions are already approved: small / known / standard, compact profile; the work fits the 16-hour claim budget.

## What we know

- `Makefile:59` invokes `go run ./cmd/changelog "$(VERSION)"`; `Makefile:63` provides read-only fragment validation.
- `internal/changelog/fold.go:39` selects all `.md` fragments and sorts filenames; `:58` trims each validated bullet; `:75` preserves released history; `:114` removes consumed fragments. Replacement and deletion are not transactional (`:19`).
- The helper uses the supplied version literally (`internal/changelog/fold.go:85`). Required `make changelog VERSION=0.9.0` therefore generates `## 0.9.0`; normalize only that newly generated heading to `## v0.9.0` afterward.
- `CHANGELOG.md:5` has empty Unreleased; earlier history begins at `CHANGELOG.md:7` with v0.8.0. There is no v0.9.0 section in the inspected snapshot.
- The snapshot contains 41 fragments under `changes/unreleased/*.md`, including `279.md:1`, `356.md:1`, and `358.md:1`. Their text describes the opt-in public personal-fork regression driver and trusted upstream reviews/approval continuity, without claiming a successful live lifecycle run.
- `changes/unreleased/282.md:1` explicitly leaves ecosystem restore adapters disabled; `311.md:1` describes installed Maven/Gradle runtime snapshots, not completed restore adapters.
- Existing coverage includes `TestFoldOrdering`, `TestFoldPreservesReleasedHistory`, `TestMakeChangelog`, `TestRepositoryUnreleasedEmpty`, and `TestCheck` in `internal/changelog/*_test.go`. Developer instructions are documented at `docs/developer.md:652`.

## What we're assuming

The coordinator supplied the intended post-merge snapshot; agents cannot establish merged status from Git metadata here. Verify completeness locally through the captured manifest, especially 279/356/358; the coordinator owns approved-base and merge checks. Do not delay implementation for those checks.

## Open questions

None blocking. Step 1 checks whether the implementation snapshot has gained additional fragments; include every valid supplied fragment, rather than freezing aggregation to today's count. A malformed fragment or partial helper failure needs diagnosis before retrying, not a blind second fold.

## Architectural context and exact changes

`internal/changelog.Fold` already implements aggregation; no code change is needed. Modify only `CHANGELOG.md` and delete the consumed `changes/unreleased/*.md` recorded in the pre-fold manifest. No new repository files or self-referential release fragment are planned. Keep scratch verification artifacts outside the deliverable. Preserve runtime, dependencies, docs, policy, and helper implementation unchanged.

## Implementation sequence

1. Capture original CHANGELOG bytes and all fragment names/content in scratch using TEST_PLAN.md's snapshot command. Confirm 279/356/358 are present. Run `make changelog-check` before consumption.
2. Run the existing approved helper exactly: `make changelog VERSION=0.9.0`. Use the developer's approved writable implementation environment; this planner snapshot is read-only outside active artifacts. Inspect a partial failure before any retry.
3. Rename the generated heading to `## v0.9.0` and insert one concise paragraph above its bullets. Describe shipped workflow reliability, recovery, validation efficiency, and public personal-fork review improvements in plain prose supported by fragments. Preserve every generated bullet verbatim and in order. Do not claim live end-to-end fork success, private/org fork support, or shipped .NET/Maven/Gradle restore adapters.
4. Run deterministic pre/post comparison and final `make changelog-check`; record focused results. Add no new tests for this aggregation-only change. Tester independently reviews completeness and summary accuracy, reusing applicable results.
5. Return the candidate for coordinator-owned formatting and complete trusted required policy once. Baseline Git checks stay with the coordinator. No role launches a full/race campaign, creates a tag, or publishes. The operator's release workflow owns full testing on the final immutable tag commit.

## HANDOFF

- Entry points: `Makefile:59`, `cmd/changelog/main.go:25`, `internal/changelog/fold.go:21`; preserve their implementation. Edit `CHANGELOG.md:5` onward only for the new section; remove captured fragments including `changes/unreleased/279.md:1`, `356.md:1`, `358.md:1`.
- Existing tests/fixtures: `internal/changelog/fold_test.go:40`, `:83`, `:219`, `:338`; `internal/changelog/check_test.go:53`, `:167`, `:211`. Preserve unchanged; no extension necessary.
- Focused commands: TEST_PLAN.md snapshot/comparison scripts, `make changelog-check` before and after, and `make changelog VERSION=0.9.0` once. Existing package regression coverage belongs to the coordinator's required policy; no duplicate role run is needed.
- Checked assumptions: read the helper and Make recipe; listed and read all fragments; inspected empty Unreleased and prior history; searched release/helper references in docs and tests. No Git-dependent assertion is needed by agents.
- Reopen the plan for required runtime/helper/policy changes, contradictory release claims requiring fragment rewrites, missing required fragments, or unresolvable malformed inputs. Additional valid merged fragments only update the manifest, not scope.
- **What this change breaks:** consumed fragment paths disappear intentionally. `TestRepositoryFragmentsValid` (`internal/changelog/check_test.go:211`) permits an empty directory; `TestRepositoryUnreleasedEmpty` (`fold_test.go:338`) remains satisfied. Helper fixtures assert literal unprefixed versions (`fold_test.go:49`); preserve them unchanged because only this release heading is normalized. `docs/developer.md:652`, `Makefile:59`, and `CHANGELOG.md:59` document the existing helper; preserve unchanged. Earlier release sections and fragment bullet text must compare exactly. No new production files are proposed, so no new-file approved-base check is required.

## Operator guidance

> Release aggregation only. Run existing make changelog VERSION=0.9.0 via the approved helper; all merged fragments including279356358 must appear exactly once. Preserve prior release history and empty Unreleased. Concise release intro, no claims of live end-to-end fork success or deferred private/org and adapter features. Snapshot has no Git metadata; baseline Git checks belong to coordinator, never block implementation. Agents never tag or publish.

<!-- swarm:guidance:end -->
